title: Common Definitions (v1)
description: Shared $defs reused across the v1 schema set. This file has no instance-level type and is only ever consumed via $ref.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the exact byte content it identifies (asset content or full raw release image).

SafeId.description: Filesystem- and URL-safe identifier. Matches the Decky v1 safe-ID rule exactly so canonical and legacy identifiers stay interchangeable.

Slug.description: Lowercase slug used for stores, retro systems, and directory segments.

SymbolicPath.description: A root-relative path using a symbolic root token (e.g. "${INBOX}/...", "${LIBRARY}/..."). Never an absolute device path, drive letter, home directory, or account-specific segment.

AssetRole.description: Semantic role an asset plays in presentation. Distinct from media type/format.

AssetRef.description: Reference to canonical, content-addressed asset content by exact-byte SHA-256, plus the role it is being used in at the point of reference.

GameRef.description: Canonical game identifier (directory slug under library/games/**).

StoreId.description: PC storefront identifier, e.g. steam, gog, epic, ea, ubisoft, itch, humble, other.

SystemId.description: Retro logical system identifier, e.g. snes, genesis, ps1, gba.

RetentionOutcome.description: Result of applying retention policy precedence (asset > role > system > source > global) to a piece of data.

ModAssignment.description: A single game's selected mod set within a profile. At most one entry per game within an enclosing array (enforced by tooling, not representable in pure JSON Schema).

game.description: Legacy/Decky-ABI game identifier this mod selection applies to (safe ID, matches profile-visible game key, not necessarily the canonical library game id).

set.description: Name of the mod set applied to the game. A complete set replaces prior selections for that game entirely (no partial/merge semantics).

Provenance.description: Where a piece of data came from and how it entered the tree.

imported_by.description: Sanitized actor label (adapter or tool name), never an account ID or personal identifier.

License.description: Explicit licensing statement. At least one of spdx_id or name must be present.
